thesis: The most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is the product-to-cart-to-checkout path, but it is bleeding value because the cart page is a dead end with no cart contents or checkout button, and product pages show a placeholder price of $1, making it impossible for users to make a purchase decision.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.summary: 4 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
findings.problem: 4 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals above the fold
findings.summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee, reviews.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Cart page dead end
findings.summary: The cart page shows only navigation with no cart contents or checkout button, preventing users from advancing to purchase.
findings.problem: The cart page shows only navigation with no cart contents or checkout button, preventing users from advancing to purchase.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Add prominent checkout button and continue-shopping link; notes: Display cart contents and clear next-step guidance.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Placeholder price on product
findings.summary: The product page displays a placeholder price of $1, making the purchase decision impossible and undermining trust in pricing accuracy.
findings.problem: The product page displays a placeholder price of $1, making the purchase decision impossible and undermining trust in pricing accuracy.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Replace with actual retail price.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: No shipping or fee disclosure
findings.summary: Across crawled pages, no shipping costs, taxes, or other fees are mentioned, so visitors cannot anticipate total cost until later in the purchase process.
findings.problem: Across crawled pages, no shipping costs, taxes, or other fees are mentioned, so visitors cannot anticipate total cost until later in the purchase process.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add shipping and fees section on product and cart pages.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “Shop our Featured 5G Routers”. | 3 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “Contact us”, “Sign in”, “Buy now”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals above fold
findings.summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee, reviews.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Competing CTAs on product pages
findings.summary: Product pages present both 'Buy now' and 'Contact us' as primary actions, splitting user focus and making the next step ambiguous.
findings.problem: Product pages present both 'Buy now' and 'Contact us' as primary actions, splitting user focus and making the next step ambiguous.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Make 'Buy now' dominant, de-emphasize 'Contact us'; notes: Single clear next step toward checkout.
findings.evidence: 3 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “Contact us”, “Sign in”, “Buy now”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Images missing alternative text
findings.summary: 3 of 33 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
findings.problem: 3 of 33 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add descriptive alt text; use alt="" only for decorative images.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 3 of 33 elements have no alt attribute.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
